mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookings (user_id, movie_id, screening_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{movieId}, #{screeningId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN screenings s ON b.screening_id = s.screening_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.booking_status = 'DONE' AND (s.screening_date + s.start_time) > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, b.movie_id, b.screening_id, b.booking_status, b.booking_date, m.title AS movie_title, s.screening_date, s.start_time, c.cinema_name, r.room_name, r.floor, (SELECT string_agg(st.row_name || st.col_num, ', ' ORDER BY st.row_name, st.col_num) FROM booked_seats bs JOIN seats st ON st.seat_id = bs.seat_id WHERE bs.booking_id = b.booking_id) AS seat_codes FROM bookings b JOIN screenings s ON s.screening_id = b.screening_id JOIN cinemas c ON c.cinema_id = s.cinema_id JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id JOIN movies m ON m.movie_id = b.movie_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND (s.screening_date, s.start_time) >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::time) ORDER BY s.screening_date, s.start_time
